headline: OpenAI says it will honor a shared robots.txt preference signal for AI training
summary: OpenAI announced on 30 October 2026 that it will honor a shared robots.txt signal for website operators to express preferences about using their content for generative-AI training, with implementation planned in the coming months. The referenced IETF document is an individual Internet-Draft, not an IETF-endorsed standard. It defines a path-specific policy token using existing robots.txt group syntax; it does not itself create a crawler directive or enforce a preference. No implementation, adoption by other providers, or change to training-data collection is established.
